interface.name: zwlr_gamma_control_manager_v1

description.summary: manager to create per-output gamma controls

interface.description: This interface allows creating gamma controls for outputs.

request.name: get_gamma_control

description.summary: create a gamma control for an output

request.description: Create a gamma control for the given output.

interface.name: zwlr_gamma_control_v1
interface.description: This interface allows adjusting the gamma ramp of an output.

event.name: gamma_size
event.description: The gamma ramp size. Sent once on creation.

request.name: set_gamma
request.description: Set the gamma ramp for the output. The array contains R, G, B values in sequence, each as a 16-bit unsigned integer. The length must be 3 * gamma_size.

event.name: failed
event.description: The gamma control failed to apply.
